record_summary: baseline Skill snapshot + tree digest; git SHA of last-green Skill
run_config: resolved model id (not alias), effort explicit, repetitions, grader version
harness: Claude Code version, release-note items, skill-creator version, permission mode, tools, CLAUDE.md digest
runs_summary: R1 reproduce on current stack (repetitions=3 for failing cases)
R2 old vs new Skill under identical model/harness (same turn, blind labels)
R3 old Skill under old model/effort vs new (model/harness isolation)
R5 single variant only if root_cause=skill; blind A/B; report-only gate
